name: Hoshina Ayaka
source:
The main heroine of this work. She left her family home during university and lived alone in a distant place, but was suddenly transferred to the academy the protagonist attends. 

An outstanding student, beautiful, athletically gifted—a flawless superwoman. Her exceptional social skills and dependable personality made her a constant favorite among her peers since childhood.

Conversely, her abilities and pride have warped her perspective, leading her to view others as little more than “puppets to be manipulated.”

She rarely shows this side, but occasionally revealed it to the protagonist—her closest confidant (one might say she trusted him).

Perhaps taking this too far, she has a history of sexually molesting the young protagonist, causing him life-altering trauma. To her, however, it seems to have been nothing more than “just another prank.”

Surprisingly, due to her “too perfect” appearance, she has never had a boyfriend and remains a virgin. While she has an intense interest in sexual matters, her high pride prevents her from ever discussing it with anyone.
